creative_direction: Render one thin porcelain sheet folded into a standing organic curve, like a quiet wave caught before it closes. Its ivory surface has a satin glaze, with a softly rounded edge and a very small unglazed foot. Light it from one broad window so the inner fold receives a warm reflected glow while the outside stays cool. Use a pale gray studio background and a subtle contact shadow. Keep the object centered and isolated, with no pedestal, tools, labels, or surrounding decor. Create a square 1024x1024 avatar with a clear central silhouette that remains legible at thumbnail size. Use an original text-only composition, without lettering, logos, signatures, or watermarks.
